name: sneak_knockout
verifies: fix-28: sneak up behind an unaware NPC with a club drawn (Parade sneak stance), power attack, Perk_KnockOut knocks it out, loot it, it gets up after its down time; a facing NPC is not unaware
notes: Spawned copies have no routine and stand still; calm keeps them from fighting back after the knock-out (the crime itself is still recorded: CombatBroadcasts.OnKnockOut). Down time of a non-party NPC is 30 s (+10 HP/s). The second NPC faces the hero, so it sees him (G3 IsInFOV: front half-space) and a power attack would only be a normal hit. fix-38: the club is drawn only behind the NPC; drawn in front of it during the spawn wait, a first perception scan could start a weapon reaction (CrimeSystem.Reacting: not Routine) before calm, and the knock-out became a normal hit (r27 run 1).
